content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-l02-h53013bc/report.rdl

Move the table down by an inch so there's breathing room under the title. Keep it at the left edge.

I moved the FleetTable down one inch, from 0.6in to 1.6in from the top of the body. It's still at the left edge (0in), and nothing else changed.

The move creates a conflict with the chart, though. The table is 0.5in tall, so it now ends at 2.1in, while HoursBySite starts at 2in. The bottom 0.1in of the table overlaps the top of the chart. I didn't move the chart because you asked me to keep the rest of the report as is. If you want, I can move HoursBySite down as well, for example to 2.2in, which would keep the gap.
